name: musik-konzert
fuer: Konzertankündigung, neue Platte, Künstlerportrait ohne Person

bild_ki.motiv: A tuba and a trumpet resting on two wooden chairs at the side of a small stage, a guitar case open on the floor, cables coiled beside a monitor speaker.
bild_ki.umgebung: The hall of a village inn converted for a concert, wooden floorboards, a vaulted plastered ceiling, rows of folding chairs.
bild_ki.heute: Modern LED stage spotlights on a metal truss, a closed laptop on a small mixing desk, a power strip taped to the floor.
bild_ki.licht: Evening soundcheck, warm amber stage light against the cool blue dusk from a side window.
bild_ki.farbwelt: amber, deep blue, brass gold, dark wood

bild_ki.motiv: Long rows of narrow folding beer tables with separate folding benches, bare wooden tops on metal legs, standing under old chestnut trees, one table already set with glasses turned upside down.
bild_ki.umgebung: A fairground at the edge of an Upper Palatinate town, gravel ground, a Ferris wheel half visible behind the trees.
bild_ki.heute: Strings of modern LED festoon lights, a mobile cash register stand, bicycles and an e-bike parked at the fence.
bild_ki.licht: Overcast late afternoon in early autumn shortly before opening, soft even light, damp gravel.
bild_ki.farbwelt: chestnut green, warm ochre gravel, pale gold light

bild_ki.motiv: Hands in fingerless gloves arranging small hand-carved wooden figures and beeswax candles on the counter of a simple wooden market stall.
bild_ki.umgebung: A Christmas market on a town square in Bavarian Swabia, plastered houses with stepped gables in the soft background.
bild_ki.heute: A card payment terminal on the counter, a modern camping heater beside the stall.
bild_ki.licht: Blue hour in December, light snow, warm tungsten bulbs inside the stall.
bild_ki.farbwelt: honey beeswax, dark green fir, cold evening blue

bild_ki.motiv: An empty small theatre stage with a single wooden table and two chairs, a coat hanging over one chair, a work light on a stand in the middle.
bild_ki.umgebung: A community theatre inside an old sandstone barn in Middle Franconia, exposed beams, red-brown sandstone walls.
bild_ki.heute: A modern black lighting rig above the stage, a tablet lying upside down on the table.
bild_ki.licht: Rehearsal light, one cool white work lamp and warm spill from the wings.
bild_ki.farbwelt: sandstone red, charcoal black, cool white

name: meldung-landschaft
fuer: neutrale Meldung, Wetter, Natur, Region allgemein

bild_ki.motiv: A harvested hop garden: very tall bare wooden poles about seven metres high in long straight rows, a high grid of wires overhead, slack strings hanging down, a single tractor small between the rows.
bild_ki.umgebung: The rolling Hallertau hill country, a small village with a church tower on the next hill, patches of forest.
bild_ki.heute: Solar panels on the roof of a large modern farm building, a wind turbine far on the horizon.
bild_ki.licht: Overcast September morning, soft even light, a thin haze in the valleys.
bild_ki.farbwelt: pale straw, sage green, silver grey sky

name: sender-radio
fuer: Neuigkeiten von Radio Boarisch, Programm, Mitmachen

bild_ki.motiv: A studio microphone on a boom arm in the foreground, a pair of closed-back headphones hanging from it, a small mixing console below.
bild_ki.umgebung: A compact radio studio built into the attic of an Upper Bavarian farmhouse, sloped wooden ceiling, acoustic panels in natural felt.
bild_ki.heute: A flat-screen monitor switched off, a modern desk lamp, a houseplant on the windowsill.
bild_ki.licht: Winter afternoon, bright snowy daylight through a roof window mixed with a warm desk lamp.
bild_ki.farbwelt: light spruce wood, felt grey, soft white

bild_ki.motiv: An empty narrow country lane leading into a wooded valley, wet asphalt, grass verges, a wooden fence along one side.
bild_ki.umgebung: A narrow valley in Franconian Switzerland, limestone rocks between the trees, a half-timbered village far away.
bild_ki.heute: A modern street lamp and a charging point for electric cars at the edge of the distant village.
bild_ki.licht: Grey November dusk after rain, cool diffuse light, the first lights in the distant village.
bild_ki.farbwelt: slate grey, dark spruce green, faint cold blue

name: nachruf-still
fuer: Nachruf, ernste Meldung (ohne Dialekt, Emojis, Hashtags)

bild_ki.motiv: A diatonic button accordion resting closed on an old wooden chair beside a window.
bild_ki.umgebung: A plain parlour with whitewashed walls and a worn wooden floor.
bild_ki.heute: A simple modern floor lamp, switched off, beside the chair.
bild_ki.licht: Quiet overcast late afternoon, soft light through a thin curtain.
bild_ki.farbwelt: muted ivory, faded walnut, soft grey
